extensionDescription.message: Connects the local AIVane desktop app to your browser for user-authorized automation and recording.

idleDescription.message: Start recording, then use the website as you normally would.

commandFailed.message: The action could not be completed.

recordingDescription.message: AIVane organizes repeated inputs and page changes automatically.

pausedDescription.message: Resume when ready. Your recorded actions are preserved.

languageHint.message: Shared with AIVane Recorder and the local Workbench on this device.

languageUnavailable.message: Open AIVane Recorder to synchronize language settings.

optionsDescription.message: Connect this browser profile to the local AIVane runtime.

profileHint.message: This profile is selected automatically by web.create and web.get. A single connected profile also works without an explicit label.

profileInvalid.message: Profile label must use 1–64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

companionMissingDescription.message: AIVane records and replays through the desktop app on this device. Install it, then start recording again.

companionStartFailedDescription.message: Open AIVane Recorder from the Start menu, then try again.

companionTimeoutTitle.message: AIVane is taking longer than expected

companionTimeoutDescription.message: The desktop app was asked to start but did not become ready. Try again, or open AIVane Recorder yourself.

companionUnsupportedDescription.message: Native messaging is unavailable here. Use Chrome or Edge 135 or later with the AIVane desktop app installed.

privacyNotice.message: Recording sends page content and form values to AIVane on this device. Avoid passwords and sensitive data. Desktop AI features may share selected content with your chosen provider.
